meta.name: scorecard-marketing
meta.description: Build quiz and assessment funnels that generate qualified leads at 30-50% conversion. Use when the user mentions "quiz funnel", "scorecard", "lead magnet", "score-based segmentation", or "lead qualification". Also trigger when designing self-assessment tools, building calculators or graders for marketing, or creating personalized result pages that drive conversions. Covers concept hooks, question design, dynamic results by tier, and automated follow-up sequences. For landing page conversion, see cro-methodology. For full marketing plans, see one-page-marketing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建测验和评估漏斗，以30-50%转化率获取合格线索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要通过互动式测验来筛选和转化潜在客户
copy.tagline_en: Build quiz and assessment funnels that generate qualified leads at 30-50% conversion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to qualify and convert leads through interactive quizzes

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你设计互动式测评（如测验、评分卡），生成从概念钩子、问题设计、按分数分层的个性化结果页到自动跟进邮件的完整流程，用于获取高质量销售线索。
howto.when: 当你提到“测评漏斗”、“评分卡”、“线索磁铁”、“基于分数的细分”或“线索资格认定”等关键词，或要求设计自评工具、营销计算器/评分器、转化导向的个性化结果页时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个“你的营销评分是多少？”的测评漏斗。
为我的健身教练业务创建一个“健身准备度评估”问卷。
写一个针对低分段的跟进邮件序列。
say.note: Claude 会根据评分层级生成个性化邮件内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design interactive assessments (quizzes, scorecards) that generate qualified leads at 30-50% conversion. It covers concept hooks, question design, dynamic results by tier, and automated follow-up sequences.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "quiz funnel", "scorecard", "lead magnet", "score-based segmentation", or "lead qualification", or when designing self-assessment tools, marketing calculators/graders, or personalized result pages for conversions.

say_en.text: Design a quiz funnel titled "What's Your Marketing Score?"
say_en.note: Claude will generate the 4-step system: hook, questions, results, follow-up.

say_en.text: Create a "Fitness Readiness Assessment" for my coaching business.
say_en.note: Claude will design 8-15 scored questions with categories and tiered results.

say_en.text: Write a follow-up email sequence for low-scoring leads.
say_en.note: Claude will personalize emails based on score tier.
